company_summary.one_line_business: We innovate and provide industrial manufacturing solutions for design-to-manufacturing of electronics and mechanical parts.

We innovate and provide industrial manufacturing solutions for design-to-manufacturing of electronics and mechanical parts. These solutions are based on a combination of hardware, software, and materials science technologies. The solutions include industrial machinery, such as those for additive manufacturing, surface-mount technology, industrial inkjet printing, along with software for design, simulation, and manufacturing management, as well as materials and consumables that are used by the machinery. These solutions are used by industrial customers in aerospace & defense, automotive, electronics, medical, research and academia, along with government organizations.
